caption: The video captures a barefoot dancer with a long ponytail, in a pink top and black wide-leg pants, seen from behind in a mirror-lined studio. She grips an open parasol in her right hand, holding the canopy edge-on at head height while her left arm stretches sideways. She lifts one foot behind, knee bent, and sustains the balance pose, her mirrored reflection repeating the stance against pale green curtains. As the parasol rises overhead, its canopy tilts to reveal the patterned face, while the left arm remains extended sideways. The raised foot lowers as she eases into a slow stride, legs opening into a walking stance. Her torso stays facing the mirror, and the mirror image remains frontal. She keeps the parasol aloft through the stride, its canopy tilting toward face-on. The lighting stands, floor fan and mirror seams stay fixed, indicating no camera motion.
